name: Hans-Peter Lehmann
bio:
Hans-Peter's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After a successful, if somewhat unfulfilling, career in financial analysis, he found himself drawn to the complex data streams generated by Formula 1. He started applying his analytical skills to publicly available race data, developing predictive models for race outcomes as a hobby. His accuracy caught the attention of a smaller racing team, where he honed his skills for several years before being headhunted by Toyota Gazoo Racing.

At Toyota, Hans-Peter is known for his meticulous approach and ability to uncover subtle but crucial patterns in the data. He's a firm believer that the difference between winning and losing often lies hidden within the numbers. What sets Hans-Peter apart is his ability to translate complex statistical findings into actionable insights that the engineers and drivers can readily understand and implement.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium height with a slight build and perpetually furrowed brow.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out slide rule, despite having access to advanced software.
Insists on using a fountain pen for all his notes.
Has a habit of muttering mathematical equations under his breath when stressed.
